The PPP is initiated by the public organization through a competitive bidding process which is traditionally led by a private organization’s bid and proposal team. Upon award of the contract, primary responsibility in the PPP transfers to an implementation team and ultimately to the production team who will lead the operations and maintenance of the PPP (Zou et al., 2014). Many of the teams may be led by varying leaders all the way from CEO to front line manager with differing levels of leadership effectiveness and accountability.
